headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 22, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a thrilling 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Ben Rice leading the offense. In other news, the Boston Red Sox took down the Baltimore Orioles 6-3, while the Orioles responded with a 5-1 win of their own. The Toronto Blue Jays' Jonatan Clase has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left plantar fasciitis.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams, with several players landing on the injured list. The Blue Jays' Jonatan Clase joins the list, as well as the Orioles' Samuel Basallo, Athletics' J.T. Ginn, Royals' Stephen Kolek and Bobby Witt Jr., Diamondbacks' Drey Jameson, Tigers' Jack Flaherty, and Rangers' Jose Corniell.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including the Astros acquiring right-handed pitcher Max Martin from the Royals. The Dodgers also made a move, acquiring Seth Halvorsen from the Rockies in exchange for Nick Frasso and Landyn Vidourek. The Athletics traded Aaron Civale to the Cubs for Aiden Moffett, while the Royals dealt Rudy Martin Jr. to the Orioles for cash.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Yankees in Thrilling 5-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a hard-fought win against the New York Yankees, with a final score of 5-3. Ben Rice led the Pirates' offense with a standout performance, hitting 1 home run and driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Yankees Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees took a 2-0 lead in the game, ultimately securing a win over the Pittsburgh Pirates. Jasson Domínguez led the Pirates' offense with a single, one RBI, and three at-bats.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Orioles 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Jake Bennett earning the win and Aroldis Chapman securing the save. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with 3 hits, including a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 5-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, led by a strong performance from their pitching staff. Dylan Beavers led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays' Clase Lands on 10-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Jonatan Clase, the Toronto Blue Jays' left fielder, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left plantar fasciitis, effective retroactive to July 21, 2026.

top_news.title: **Astros Acquire RHP Max Martin in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Max Martin in a trade. Martin joins the Astros after being dealt from the Kansas City Royals.
